page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, resulting in 2 threads per core. It includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB memory-per-core ratio, and has a 35 MB L3 cache. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type.

Performance benchmarks indicate a moderate capability profile. While single-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is positioned in the lower 25th percentile, multi-core CPU performance and Passmark CPU scores reach average mid-tier levels. Memory bandwidth tests, including uncached large-block read and write operations, consistently register average performance, with read speeds reaching 49.44 GB/sec. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported by hardware-level instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a dedicated compute allocation suitable for workloads requiring predictable CPU access without burstable limitations. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-threaded performance, this instance is suited for compute-bound tasks, software compilation, database operations, and moderate Redis caching workloads rather than memory-intensive or high-throughput web serving.
